title: The Most Expensive Pickups You Can Buy in 2026 (One Costs $122,265)
description:
In nineteen twenty-five, Ford's first factory pickup cost two hundred eighty-one dollars. In twenty twenty-six, a fully loaded Ford pickup can cost one hundred twenty-two thousand. The average full-size pickup in America now sells for more than sixty-seven thousand dollars. And at least nine pickups on sale right now cost more than ninety thousand. Here are the most expensive pickups you can buy, and the twist about who is actually buying them.

Every figure in this video comes from a published source, listed below.

Get the 2027 Truck Buyer's Guide: [LINK HERE]

0:00 Intro
1:42 What a normal truck costs in 2026
3:46 5. Chevrolet Silverado ZR2 Bison
5:33 4. Toyota Tundra Capstone
7:22 3. GMC Sierra Denali Ultimate
9:08 2. Ram 1500 RHO (and the 2027 TRX)
11:28 1. Ford F-150 Raptor R
13:09 The $100,000+ electric trucks
16:31 Who buys them and the real cost
19:29 What to check before you buy in 2027
